gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve the currently selected time tracking implementation for my Jira project so that I can ensure it aligns with our team's workflow.
gold.ideal: The API should return the currently selected time tracking implementation, including details such as the implementation name and any relevant configuration settings.

gold.user: As an admin, I need to update the time tracking implementation for our Jira projects to use the new time tracking tool that integrates better with our existing systems.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully update the time tracking implementation and return a confirmation message along with the new configuration details.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to see a list of all available time tracking implementations so that I can choose the best one for our project requirements.
gold.ideal: The API should return a comprehensive list of available time tracking implementations, including their names, descriptions, and any specific features.

gold.user: As a team lead, I want to access the shared time tracking configuration to ensure all team members are using the same settings for consistency in reporting.
gold.ideal: The API should return the current shared time tracking configuration, including settings that affect all projects and teams.
